sections.title: Welcome to Linear Equations!
learning_goals: Get ready to explore the world of linear equations in two variables.
sections.renderer_reasoning: Standard introductory section with avatar only.

sections.title: What You'll Learn Today
learning_goals: Define and understand pairs of linear equations.
Formulate equations from word problems.
Solve equations using graphical, substitution, and elimination methods.
Identify different types of solutions (unique, no solution, infinite).
Apply algebraic conditions to determine solution types.
Tackle advanced word problems.
sections.renderer_reasoning: Overview of learning objectives presented with avatar and bullet points.

sections.title: Understanding Linear Equations in Two Variables
learning_goals: Define linear equations in two variables and their general form.
Explain the concept of simultaneous equations.
Understand why two equations are needed for two unknowns.
sections.renderer_reasoning: Manim is ideal for displaying mathematical definitions, general forms, and illustrating the components of linear equations.

sections.title: Translating Word Problems into Equations
learning_goals: Convert real-world scenarios into pairs of linear equations.
Identify variables and relationships within word problems.
Practice forming equations from various problem types like sum/difference and cost problems.
sections.renderer_reasoning: Manim can visually break down word problems, highlight key information, and animate the step-by-step formation of equations.

sections.title: Solving Graphically: Intersecting, Parallel, and Coincident Lines
learning_goals: Solve pairs of linear equations by plotting them on a Cartesian plane.
Identify the point of intersection as the solution.
Distinguish between intersecting, parallel, and coincident lines.
Relate line types to unique, no, or infinitely many solutions.
sections.renderer_reasoning: Manim is perfect for animating the plotting of lines, showing their intersection, and clearly differentiating between parallel and coincident lines on a graph.

sections.title: Algebraic Solutions: Substitution Method
learning_goals: Apply the substitution method to solve pairs of linear equations.
Express one variable in terms of the other.
Perform substitution and solve for the remaining variable.
sections.renderer_reasoning: Manim can clearly demonstrate the step-by-step process of the substitution method, highlighting which parts of the equation are being manipulated.

sections.title: Algebraic Solutions: Elimination Method
learning_goals: Utilize the elimination method to solve pairs of linear equations.
Manipulate coefficients to eliminate one variable.
Solve the resulting single-variable equation.
sections.renderer_reasoning: Manim is excellent for showing the alignment of equations, multiplication of terms, and the process of adding or subtracting equations to eliminate a variable.

sections.title: Algebraic Conditions for Solution Types
learning_goals: Determine the nature of solutions (unique, no, infinite) using algebraic conditions.
Analyze the ratios of coefficients (a1/a2, b1/b2, c1/c2).
Connect algebraic conditions to graphical representations (intersecting, parallel, coincident).
sections.renderer_reasoning: Manim can display the formulas for coefficient ratios and visually link them to the different solution types, making abstract concepts concrete.

sections.title: Solving Advanced Word Problems (HOTS)
learning_goals: Apply linear equation solving techniques to complex word problems.
Develop strategies for setting up equations for 'HOTS' questions.
Solve problems involving two-digit numbers and reversing digits.
sections.renderer_reasoning: Manim can break down complex word problems into manageable steps, showing the derivation of equations and the solution process clearly.

sections.title: Test Your Knowledge!
learning_goals: Recall definitions and general forms of linear equations.
Practice solving equations using various methods.
Apply knowledge to determine solution types and solve word problems.
sections.renderer_reasoning: Interactive quiz format with questions and answers presented as flashcards.

sections.title: Key Takeaways: Flashcard Review
learning_goals: Reinforce understanding of key definitions and methods.
Review important formulas and conditions for linear equations.
sections.renderer_reasoning: Flashcard-style review of main concepts and formulas for memory retention.

sections.title: Linear Equations: A Quick Review
learning_goals: Summarize the main concepts covered in the video.
Revisit the importance and applications of linear equations.
sections.renderer_reasoning: A dynamic visual recap of the entire lesson, reinforcing key points with engaging animations and a summary of the journey.
